resposta: Genesis 6–9 narrates a judgment by water: Earth filled with violence; Noah builds an ark; animals enter; it rains forty days; waters prevail a hundred fifty days; they cover “all the high mountains”; the ark rests; a new beginning with covenant and rainbow. The text speaks of fifteen cubits above the mountains (Gen 7:20), fountains of the great deep and windows of heaven. This theme does not mock faith: it asks, with public math and evidence, whether a literal global physical flood holds.
aprofundar: Details used in the following calculations: cubit ≈ 45.7 cm; Everest 8,849 m; 40 days of rain; ~150 days prevailing; about a year in the narrative until exit; ark 300×50×30 cubits; eight people; animals in pairs and, in places, seven pairs of clean animals. Internal tensions (40 vs 150 days; one pair vs seven) match interwoven sources (J/P). Practice: read Gen 6–9 once and mark what is number, dialogue, or theology.
camada3: To contemplate: a community may keep a sacred story as a moral mirror—justice, violence, restart—without needing every cubic meter to be meteorology. The Portal separates respect for spiritual search from testable physical claims.

tema: Where would the water to cover Everest come from?
resposta: To cover Everest plus fifteen cubits, the water height is about 8,856 m. In a simplified uniform shell over Earth's whole surface (≈5.1×10⁸ km²), the extra volume is on the order of 4.5×10⁹ km³—about 3.4× all ocean water and hundreds of thousands of times atmospheric water. There is no known reservoir for that water, nor a physical place for it to go afterward.
aprofundar: Formula: V≈A×H with H=8849+15×0.457 m. Declared simplification: we do not model every valley; the order of magnitude already exceeds surface and atmospheric stocks. “Fountains of the deep” at that scale bring lethal heat and volume. Offline calculator: conteudo/calculadora-diluvio.html.
camada3: To contemplate: when numbers leave Earth's real scale, the issue is category. Theological miracle and planetary hydrology are different kinds of claim.

tema: Forty days of rain and condensation heat
resposta: If ~8,856 m fell in 40 days, the average rate would be ~221 m/day ≈ 9,200 mm/h worldwide. World 24-hour rainfall records are near ~1,800 mm/day—orders of magnitude lower. Condensing ~4.5×10²¹ kg of water releases latent heat Q=m·L_v ≈10²⁸ J. Put into the atmosphere alone, that implies a ΔT of millions of kelvin—absurd for life.
aprofundar: Even spreading Q across all ocean mass yields a devastating global thermal jump. The problem is energy as well as source. See the calculator for formulas.
camada3: To contemplate: physics is not the enemy of the sacred; it refuses to pretend. A cleansing symbol may remain; literal global meteorology does not.

tema: The ark: wood, space, food, manure, and eight people
resposta: With a 45.7 cm cubit, the ark is ~137×23×14 m (~43,000 m³ gross). The largest well-documented wooden ship (Wyoming schooner, ~100 m hull) already flexed and leaked. Counting only modern vertebrates (~37,000 species) with one pair, plus seven pairs for a “clean” fraction, yields tens of thousands of individuals—still without insects. Food, fresh water, manure, and ammonia with “one window” (Gen 6:16) and eight caretakers do not add up.
aprofundar: Orders of magnitude: ~0.5 kg food/animal/day → hundreds of tonnes/year. Task rates per person become impossible. Adjust species and rations in the calculator.
camada3: To contemplate: a story may teach obedience and care without being a shipyard manual.

tema: How would the kangaroo reach the ark—and return only to Australia?
resposta: Kangaroos and koalas live in Australia; sloths in South America; penguins and polar bears at the poles. Reaching the Near East means thousands of kilometers and oceans. Koalas need eucalyptus. Afterward, marsupials would have to return and remain only in Australia—opposite of the record. Two individuals per species imply a genetic bottleneck not seen as a single global funnel ~4,350 years ago.
aprofundar: Even miraculous rafting fails on diet, travel time, and repopulation. The calculator estimates a hypothetical overland travel time to show the premise’s absurdity.
camada3: To contemplate: respecting the map of life is honesty before mystery, not an attack on Noah as symbol.

tema: Chronology, civilizations, and what Earth recorded
resposta: Ussher-style chronologies place the flood near 2348 BCE. Egypt’s Old Kingdom, Sumer, the Indus, and China show continuity—no global hiatus. Ice cores with >100 kyr of annual layers, varves, tree rings, and reefs lack a single recent global flood bed. Eight people repopulating Earth to known historical numbers needs impossible demography and would erase observed genetic diversity.
aprofundar: A recent global flood predicts global mud, synchronous extinction, a genetic funnel, civilizational collapse. That pattern is not what we see. Regional floods are.
camada3: To contemplate: humans remember water trauma because floods destroy real cities. The question is scale: valley or whole planet?

tema: What matches: local floods and Near Eastern myths
resposta: Flood deposits at sites such as Shuruppak/Ur (~2900 BCE) and Euphrates floods are real local catastrophes. Atrahasis, Gilgamesh XI, and Ziusudra tell boat-and-water stories older than Genesis’s final form. Inside Gen 6–9, traditions mix (40 vs 150 days; one pair vs seven): J/P literary stitching. The Black Sea hypothesis remains debated.
aprofundar: Reading Genesis beside Gilgamesh XI situates the text in a Near Eastern family of narratives. Many theologians accept that and still pray with the text.
camada3: To contemplate: sometimes spiritual truth travels inside a boat story like a seed inside fruit. The fruit may be regional; the seed, ethical.

tema: How could millions of animal species fit in such a small ark?
palavras: millions of animals on the ark
resposta: This is where a literal reading is squeezed hardest. With a 45.7 cm cubit, the ark is ~137×23×14 m — gross volume ≈ 43,000 m³ (≈ 43 million liters). Land vertebrates described today alone (mammals ~6,400, birds ~11,000, reptiles ~12,000, amphibians ~8,000 → ~37,400 species), applying Genesis 7:2–3 (seven pairs of clean animals and of birds; one pair of the others), exceed ~200,000 individuals. That is ~0.18 m³ per animal — about 180 liters — for body, a year of food, water, and movement, averaging elephant and hummingbird together. Add described terrestrial biota including insects (~1.3–1.5 million species) or the ~8.7 million species estimate (Mora et al. 2011) minus ~2.2 million marine (~6.5 million terrestrial), and “space” falls to a few liters or ~2 liters each. This is geometry, not mockery. As literal global history it does not add up; as a religious narrative inspired by real local floods and older myths, the ark’s size works as symbol, not as a planetary cargo ship.
aprofundar: Three tiers in the Flood Calculator (Ark capacity mode): (A) land vertebrates only ~37k species → ~200k+ animals → ~0.18 m³/animal; (B) described terrestrial species incl. insects ~1.4M → millions of individuals → ~9 L/animal; (C) ~8.7M total minus ~2.2M marine → ~6.5M terrestrial → tens of millions of individuals → ~2 L/animal. Add food, water, manure, and care by 8 people. Sources: vertebrate catalogs/IUCN; Mora et al. 2011 (PLoS Biology).
camada3: To contemplate: asking “how does it fit?” does not insult Noah as a figure of obedience — it refuses to treat theology as a global zoo inventory.

tema: Animal journeys: continents, oceans, and the return home
resposta: Read as literal global transport to the Ararat region (~39.7°N 44.3°E), each biome requires a trip biology does not allow. Kangaroo, koala, wombat from Australia (~11–13k km) with the Indian Ocean in the way — koalas need Australian eucalyptus. Sloth, armadillo, llama from South America (~11–13k km) across the Atlantic; sloths move ~0.2 km/h. Antarctic penguins and Arctic polar bears need ice and cold-water prey — incompatible with Anatolian highlands. Madagascar lemurs (~6,500 km) do not cross the Mozambique Channel (~400 km of sea). Galápagos tortoises and New Zealand kiwi are island endemics. North American bison (~10k km) still face the Atlantic. Even when continuous land travel would take dozens or thousands of days, the decisive barrier is the ocean. Returning only to the home continent requires the same miracle twice. Extinct species would add to the cast, not shrink it. As literal history: ❌. As religious narrative with symbolic animals / local floods: fits the genre.
aprofundar:
Use Calculator → Journeys mode. Also checkable: dove/olive after ~1 year under seawater (❌/⚠️); Noah at 600 and family of 8 (genetic bottleneck); Gen 6:3 120 years; Gen 7:11–8:14 chronology; raven; sacrifice of clean animals after landing; carnivores' food after disembarking.

Quotations: Genesis 8:4 (King James Version): “And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.” | Genesis 7:4 (King James Version): “For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.”
camada3: Biogeography is not the enemy of faith — it is the enemy of turning theology into a global shipping inventory.

tema: The portrait of God in the flood story
resposta: We do not judge anyone's sincere faith, and we do not diagnose God, Noah, or the authors. Psychology/psychiatry cannot diagnose literary characters or deity — say that plainly. We can rigorously read the portrait the text paints: a transparent balance of acts attributed to God in Gen 6–9, then compare with human ethics and how different readers answer. Acts in the text: decide to destroy humans and animals (Gen 6:7), including children and animals with no narrated guilt; 'regretted' making humankind (Gen 6:6); flood; then Gen 8:21 'I will not again curse the ground…' while admitting the human heart is still evil; covenant/rainbow (Gen 9). If a human ruler did the same, ethics would speak of collective and disproportionate punishment — not a psychiatric label. Eternal hell is NOT in this text (see the app's hell lessons). Readings: Jewish midrash (120 years as call to repent); Christian theodicy/allegory; progressive scholarship; critics (e.g. Ehrman, God's Problem); Mesopotamian Atrahasis background. Mestre Solar: the 'cruel God' image says more about ancient authors' worldview than about the divine; question fear-based images of God without mocking believers.
aprofundar:
Calculator → Portrait / coherence mode. Logic table: omniscience vs regret; love vs collective destruction; omnipotence vs a flood that doesn't fix the heart (Gen 8:21); later eternal punishment vs finite acts. Epicurean trilemma (Lactantius)/Hume; replies: Plantinga free-will defense; Hick soul-making; symbolic reading; open theism; annihilationism/universalism — and why critics find them insufficient. Verdict: logical tensions are real for THIS portrayal. Scholarly consensus: human authors (J/P), adapted Mesopotamian myths. Not a 'scientific proof God does not exist'. Do not call the authors mentally ill. Room remains to seek the divine without fear.

Quotations: Genesis 6:6 (King James Version): “And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.” | Genesis 6:7 (King James Version): “And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.” | Genesis 8:4 (King James Version): “And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.” | Genesis 8:21 (King James Version): “And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart
is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.”
camada3: Distinguishing a tribal fear-God from the Mystery many call love is spiritual maturity — not an insult to others' faith.

tema: Let's think together: the kangaroo's journey
resposta: Guided walkthrough: (1) Kangaroos only in Australia/NG. (2) Ark rests on mountains of Ararat — Genesis 8:4 KJV. (3) ~12,000 km. (4) Ocean + Wallace Line; can't cross open ocean. (5) Sustained ~20–40 km/day vs Gen 7:4 seven days. (6) Food/water/climate. (7) Return with no fossils along route. (8) Repeat koala/sloth/penguin. (9) Literally impossible → human religious narrative. Respectful of faith. Quote Gen 8:4 KJV and Gen 7:4 KJV in Calculator → Think together.
aprofundar:
Open Calculator → Think together / Journeys. Sources: Gen 8:4; Gen 7:4; Wallace Line; Macropodidae.

Quotations: Genesis 8:4 (King James Version): “And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.” | Genesis 7:4 (King James Version): “For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.”
camada3: Thinking together respects the reader: follow the chain until literality breaks.

tema: A lie repeated many times — and the right to ask
resposta:
In Mestre Solar's words: a lie — or an unexamined story — repeated many times can become “truth” in a person's mind, rooted in the subconscious, rarely questioned. This is not an insult to believers: it is cognitive psychology.

Science names the **illusory truth effect**: repetition increases perceived truth even when people know better (Hasher, Goldstein & Toppino, 1977; Fazio et al., 2015). Nearby: processing fluency; belief perseverance; childhood repetition plus authority.

The famous saying often blamed on Goebbels is **not documented** as his — treat it as a popular, misattributed proverb.

Gently tied to the flood: many heard Genesis 6–9 from childhood as settled fact. Examining verses, physics, and Near Eastern parallels is not a duty to abandon faith — it is the right not to let fear or habit think for you. Invite: question with calm, not fear. Sincere faith can bear light.
aprofundar: Hasher et al. 1977; Fazio et al. 2015; Quote Investigator on the misattribution. Return to the Calculator and “Think together.”
camada3: The subconscious is a garden: what you plant by repetition, you harvest as “obvious.”

resposta: Portal verdict: water volume ❌; rain and latent heat ❌; fountains of the deep ❌; pressure/oxygen and salinity ❌; ark structure and logistics ❌; biogeography and pair genetics ❌; Ussher chronology vs civilizations and layered geology ❌. Local Mesopotamian floods ✅; Atrahasis/Gilgamesh/Ziusudra parallels ✅; J/P stitching ✅; Black Sea ⚠️. Overall: a literal global flood as physical reportage of Genesis 6–9 does not hold. That does not license mocking believers: many read it as theological narrative about violence, covenant, and restart, echoing real floods and older myths. Lying about Earth’s physics does not strengthen faith; honesty does.
aprofundar: Open the Flood Calculator (conteudo/calculadora-diluvio.html), vary height, rain days, and species, and watch the formulas. If your faith is literalist, this will sting—and the Portal prefers true discomfort to false comfort.
camada3: To contemplate: the courage to say “it doesn’t match” can be as spiritual as the courage to wait for a miracle.
